rawSiteProfile.notes:
GoDaddy OLS storefront (React SPA, server: DPS/2.0.0, no WAF).

Rendering: Playwright is required — production catalog-crawler.ts:403-413 + watermark-crawler.ts:143-159 auto-fallback fires when static HTML > 5KB returns 0 products. Selector: [data-aid="PRODUCT_LIST_RENDERED"] [data-ux="GridCell"] at generic-retail.ts:431.

Sort (VERIFIED 2026-04-07): ?sortOption=descend_by_created_at. Discovered by driving the [data-aid="PRODUCT_SORT_DROPDOWN"] control in a live Playwright session and clicking the "Newest" option — the URL updated and the mysimplestore XHR fired with q[descend_by_created_at]=true. Three prior audits concluded "no sort exists" because they never clicked the dropdown. Default page-1 first product = "Glock 21/41 Magazine"; with sort applied = "Brazilian M1935 Oberndorf 7mm Mauser" (matches mysimplestore truly-newest).

Pagination: ?page=N, perPage=15. Combine with sort as ?page={N}&sortOption=descend_by_created_at. Total ~128 pages; last page has 6 products. 128*15 - 9 = 1911 products verified three ways (live last-page count, mysimplestore total_count, sitemap-filtered).

Watermark method: navigate-from-watermark (changed from full-catalog-sweep 2026-04-07 after sort discovery).

API alternative: mysimplestore.com /api/v2/products with storeId 31990017-c17c-4c86-89ca-5fc9b6a1bb06 — returns all fields T1 needs (created_at, total_count, in_stock, total_on_hand, etc.) and is ~47x faster than Playwright HTML route (~150ms vs ~7s). See siteProfile.apiAlternative. Phase 2 of the audit will wire this as the priority T1 path with the Playwright HTML route as fallback.

wafWorkaround.notes: GoDaddy OLS storefront is a React SPA with no server-side product HTML. No WAF (server: DPS/2.0.0). Playwright is required to render the product grid. The production catalog-crawler/watermark-crawler auto-fallback (catalog-crawler.ts:403-413, watermark-crawler.ts:143-159) detects 0 products from large static HTML and re-fetches via fetchWithPlaywright(), which works on first try.

apiAlternative.notes: Verified live 2026-04-07. ~47x faster than Playwright HTML route. Returns total_count + created_at + in_stock + total_on_hand. Will be wired as priority T1 path in Phase 2 of audit.
